title: Job Keeps Trusting
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler whose gift is a brave heart, and tonight Job loses nearly everything and still bows down to trust Heavenly Father: Beau cries over his broken toy, then takes a breath and remembers that Heavenly Father still loves him.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because he trusts Heavenly Father even when things are hard. In Beau’s world today: Beau’s favorite toy broke, and he felt so sad — he even cried a little. But after his tears, Beau took a breath and remembered that Heavenly Father still loved him and would help him feel better. Just like Job kept trusting through his hard day, Beau learned that we can be sad AND still trust Heavenly Father at the same time.
